_comment: Preference category tree per workspace. All three root categories (system, transactional, promotional) MUST be present — the API rejects a partial tree. SuprSend derives each category's slug from its NAME (the `category` field is informational here): 'Order updates' → order-updates, '&' → 'and'. Keep name and slug consistent, because every workflow's `category` (see workflows.json) must match the derived slug or publishing that workflow fails with a 400 ('<category>' not found). Seed BEFORE workflows. Both workspaces share the SAME four default categories — that sameness is the point: WorkVibe's customers are all restaurant chains running the same core notifications. Each customer then adds its own: Ember & Oak a transactional `feedback` category, Nolan's a promotional `offers` category.
